Run inside Herdr

          

        

        
The working loop
  1. Open herdr from your normal terminal.
  2. Navigate inside Herdr, then run hdw cc or hdw oc.
  3. Use Prefix → Tab to cycle AI, editor and shell panes. Prefix → z zooms the focused pane.
  4. Review changes in Neovim with Space → g → d.
  5. Return to an existing workspace with Prefix → w; detach with Prefix → d.
Every hdw call creates another workspace, including -c. The original caller remains. Bare hdw shows usage; outside-Herdr calls refuse.
If setup fails, read the reported original/new context. The new workspace/root is retained for inspection; preserve uncertain state.

      Reference baselines
      Reviewed . Each source below records its own scope and freshness. Host configuration and installed source were inspected on Omarchy; WSL behavior is based on its repository and pinned plugins, with actual-host checks tracked in its maintenance guide. Client documentation, source snapshots and installed-release evidence remain distinct. Consolidating the guide does not advance these baselines.
      Herdr map: Omarchy-style Ctrl+Space. Generic upstream Herdr defaults differ, including detach and close actions. Use the matching map on the current host.
      Scope: the complete hdw launcher interface and a practical reference across its applications and AI workflows. Each application's live help owns its full evolving catalog.
      Counts measure reference entries, not individual shortcuts or comparable capability totals. Some entries group related actions. Host totals differ through terminal/desktop coverage and grouping; the core workspace and AI reference is shared.
      
      
      
      
      Open and maintain the guide
      Open docs/workspace-guide.html from the EyrAgents checkout, then select your host. On GitHub, download the raw HTML first. Everything needed for the interface is embedded; source links use the network only when selected.
      Search works across action names, commands, modes and details. Stars and theme are browser-local; they do not sync between hosts. Import saved-key exports from the former host or AI guide to transfer favorites. Print view includes the current results and their context.
      Guide sources and rebuild instructions: docs/workspace-guide-src/README.md. Run make workspace-guide in EyrAgents; its make check rejects stale HTML. Both host profiles and all client controls are built here.
      Every in-scope binding or command change includes guide reconciliation. Host/default updates use the owning repository's /omasync; AI-client controls and workflows use /eyrsync. The generator checks file consistency. Source and live-help review establish the documented controls.
